title: Silver Springs Jungle Kayaking and Paddleboarding
includes: Vessel, Paddles, Life Vests For Adults & Kids, Safety Whistle, Dry Bags (Upon Request) & Digital Map of Route.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Whether you're seeking a peaceful escape, a family outing, or a one-of-a-kind adventure, Silver Springs is the place for you. 
Glide across some of the clearest waters in the world, where ancient springs bubble up from the Earth and the forest feels alive!
Couples will love the quiet moments—drifting beneath towering cypress trees, sunlight filtering through the moss, and maybe even sharing a surprise encounter with manatees. 
Families will find excitement spotting turtles, birds, fish, and maybe even wild monkeys on the treetops. There’s nothing like paddling deeper into the winding creeks, where every turn brings wonder.
Your time on the water will be serene, thrilling, and unforgettable. Experience Florida’s natural attraction the way it was meant to be—up close, and personal!

IMPORTANT:
Guests will be paired in tandem (2-person) kayaks, except for those who choose the paddleboard option. If the total number of guests is odd, one person will be assigned a single (1-person) kayak.
